title: Your first little world
introduction: A new guest starts from the public homepage and enters a local workspace without an account. Build Your Tank makes aquarium planning approachable; in this demo, I will build a habitat, learn about its inhabitants, and connect everyday care with the health of a small ecosystem.
closing: The goal is to connect creative choices with informed care, so a beginner can understand the world they are building. This working prototype saves locally and shares snapshots. Cloud accounts and a live community are future steps; the water and growth models are simplified educational estimates.

steps.title: Meet your workspace
steps.summary: One place for your tanks, supplies and daily care.
instructions: Look at the starter tank and the collection above it. Each tank keeps its own setup and care history.
Use the four navigation tabs to explore. Coins and care supplies are shared by all your tanks.
steps.narration: A starter tank makes the workspace immediately explorable. My tanks, inspiration, the store, and the learning library connect building with learning. Coins and care supplies are shared across my collection.
steps.recording: 从首页点击 Build your first tank，输入昵称进入。展示欢迎指引并开始，然后停留在 My tanks。录制前使用独立浏览器配置，避免影响已有鱼缸。

steps.title: Find a starting idea
steps.summary: Explore an example before making your own choices.
instructions: Filter Tank idea by style and open an example to inspect its fish, plants and water status.
Observe tank opens a closer view. Make my own copy buys a separate tank if you have enough coins; copying is optional.
steps.narration: Tank idea gives beginners a starting point. I can inspect the inhabitants and equipment of an example before building. Purchasing a separate copy is also possible, while preserving my existing tanks.
steps.recording: 打开一个示例缸，展示物种和配置，关闭弹窗即可。主线演示自行搭建，不购买示例副本，以保持预算和操作连贯。示例不是实时社区用户。

steps.title: Create a tank of your own
steps.summary: Give your new world a name and a place in the room.
instructions: Choose New tank, enter a name, and compare 60cm, 120cm and 150cm against the same furniture.
Choose a size and glass finish within your budget, then create the tank. Switch collection cards to return to another tank.
You can rename the selected tank later using the name field above its room view.
steps.narration: I will create Quiet Garden. Comparing three sizes against the same furniture makes space a visible design decision. Each tank is independent, so switching between designs preserves the choices I have already made.
steps.recording: 新建 Quiet Garden，依次点选尺寸展示比例，最终选 60cm 和 Regular glass，点击创建。切换旧缸再切回新缸，展示隔离保存。

steps.title: Build the habitat first
steps.summary: Choose the space, substrate, glass and filtration.
instructions: Open Edit setup to adjust tank size, glass finish, substrate and filtration.
Upgrades spend the price difference and trade-ins refund it. The room view and learning status respond to your setup.
steps.narration: Before adding inhabitants, I choose their habitat: the tank, glass, substrate, and filter. Upgrades spend the difference in demo coins, and trade-ins refund it, making equipment and budget choices easy to explore.
steps.recording: 打开 Edit setup，选择 ADA Aqua Soil Amazonia，保留海绵过滤。展示可修改的尺寸、玻璃和过滤字段。不要为了镜头连续购买昂贵升级。

steps.title: Learn before you choose
steps.summary: Understand an inhabitant before bringing it home.
instructions: Search Learn for Betta, open the Bettas group, then open the Betta encyclopedia entry.
Read habitat, temperament, tankmate and care information. The library also covers plants, substrates, equipment and supplies.
Browse categories and fish groups to compare related species, then return to the library or keep an entry link for later.
steps.narration: Learn connects a visual preference with an informed choice. Searching for a betta opens information about its habitat, temperament, and care needs. The library also explains plants, equipment, and supplies.
steps.recording: 搜索 Betta，进入 Bettas 群组，展示群组介绍，再打开 Betta 词条查看栖息地与同缸兼容信息。说明本次展示单只斗鱼的设计选择，避免把默认示例缸视为真实饲养建议。

steps.title: Bring your world to life
steps.summary: Shop for the selected tank, one addition at a time.
instructions: Check Shopping for before buying. Search or filter fish, open species details, and add a suitable inhabitant.
Switch to Plants to add greenery. Fish and plants go directly into the selected tank; removing one refunds its demo price.
steps.narration: In Fish store, I check which tank I am shopping for. Species details connect to the library. I will add one betta and two plants to Quiet Garden, then see those choices appear in my tank.
steps.recording: 确认 Shopping for 为 Quiet Garden。搜索 Betta，只添加 1 只；清空搜索，切 Plants，添加 Anubias Kirin 与 Rotala 各 1。回到 My tanks 展示结果。

steps.title: Take a closer look
steps.summary: Move from a room view to the details of your aquarium.
instructions: Choose Observe tank on the room view to open the aquarium close-up.
Use zoom, scroll or swipe to look around. Reset view returns to 100%; zoom changes your view, not the tank size.
steps.narration: Observe tank moves from the room to a close-up. I can zoom and look around, then reset the view without changing the aquarium itself.
steps.recording: 打开 Observe tank，放大到 150%，稍作横向滚动，再 Reset view，关闭。鱼的移动是展示动画。

steps.title: Understand the water
steps.summary: Explore how a habitat is more than what you can see.
instructions: Read the inhabitants, pH and space status, then find Water & nutrients beside the tank.
Explore pH, temperature, hardness, four separate plant nutrients and CO₂. Raising a nutrient uses a matching purchased demo dose; these sliders are not water tests or real dosing instructions.
steps.narration: Water settings make less visible conditions readable. Changing temperature can trigger an educational warning. These are simplified demo settings, not live measurements; hardness is saved as a reference rather than modeled chemically.
steps.recording: 展示 Water & nutrients，将温度从 25 改为 32，展示警告，再恢复 25。不要说成传感器监测、真实水质检测或物种精确预测。

steps.title: Prepare for daily care
steps.summary: Know where your coins and supplies go.
instructions: Open My bag to see shared food portions, water refills and separate potassium, nitrogen, iron and phosphorus fertilizer doses.
Daily check-in grants 20 coins once per local date. In Fish store, Care supplies buys packs into your shared bag, not into one tank.
steps.narration: My bag keeps supplies together across tanks. Daily check-in earns demo coins, and care supplies can be restocked in the store for future routines.
steps.recording: 展示 My bag 后关闭，领取 Daily check-in 的 20 coins（已领取则展示状态）。进入 Fish store → Care supplies 购买一包食物和一瓶钾肥，展示库存增加。

steps.title: Practice a small daily routine
steps.summary: Feed, refresh the water and care for your plants.
instructions: Feed fish uses one food portion and earns 5 coins. Change water uses one refill and earns 8 coins.

Care for plants uses one purchased potassium demo dose and raises its slider. The other nutrients use their own purchased doses through the four sliders. Each care action is available once per tank per local day.
steps.narration: Feeding and water care consume supplies and reward attention with demo coins. Plant care uses a purchased potassium demo dose; the other nutrients have their own store items and sliders. Each task records completion for this tank and day.
steps.recording: 确保选中 Quiet Garden，依次 Feed fish、Change water、Care for plants。每个动画停留约 2 秒，展示完成状态和库存扣减。重录请使用新的演示鱼缸，勿删除已有作品。

steps.title: Look ahead and reflect
steps.summary: Use the 30-day estimate to review your choices.
instructions: Open 30 days later to review the estimated water balance, greenery and available space.
Treat the result as a simplified learning prompt assuming regular care. Previewing does not advance time or change the saved tank.
steps.narration: The thirty-day preview brings these choices together in an outlook for water balance, greenery, and space. It is a simplified learning estimate, inviting me to review the habitat and consider improvements.
steps.recording: 打开 30 days later，展示三个结果。它不会真的播放 30 天成长，也不会修改存档；旁白明确为简化学习估计。

steps.title: Keep it and pass it on
steps.summary: Save your work, share a snapshot and keep exploring.
instructions: Your workspace saves automatically in this browser; Save tank confirms a local save.
Share tank creates a read-only snapshot link. A viewer can purchase a separate copy. In my gallery shows a tank in this browser’s Tank idea gallery; it does not publish online.
steps.narration: My work saves in this browser. Share tank creates a read-only snapshot that someone can inspect and copy separately. I can revisit the guide, or edit its order, instructions, and recording narration as the project develops.
steps.recording: 先点 Save tank，再打开 Share tank 复制链接；可在另一个标签展示只读快照。返回展示 In my gallery 开关和指引编辑入口，结束于完成页。正式录制使用可访问的托管地址，本地链接无法供评审直接访问。
